entries.name: Bowmanship Doctrine V
entries.text: MANDATORY per OP: Arrow Rain deals 75% of unit's base piercing per hit, +150 piercing DMG, allows shooting where you want with increased range, aim-bots to closest target in circle. OP verbatim: "Arrow Rain is MANDATORY because normal V is really bad on Hwarang."

entries.name: Projectile Doctrine V
entries.text: +60% ammo, +50 piercing AP. Mandatory per Amya.

entries.name: Precision Doctrine V
entries.text: +120 piercing DMG, +80 piercing AP, +9% rate of fire. Mandatory per Amya.

entries.name: Artemis
entries.text: Unit-unique: unlocks Double Strings, fires 2 arrows per shot for 12s, 40s CD, can't combine with other actives except Overwatch. Top pick.

entries.name: Epic Leadership Doctrine
entries.text: Replaces Unit DMG V on this unit. OP verbatim: "only unit in the game where Leadership is more value than Unit DMG." Top pick.

entries.name: Whistling Arrow Doctrine V
entries.text: Alt for Artemis: every 3 hits inflict bleeding for 12% current health, can trigger in concert with other units, enables hits at weak points. OP verbatim: "GREAT in duo-Hwarang" -- duo-play swap: if you and an ally both run Hwarang, replace Artemis with Whistling Arrow on at least one of the two (bleed triggers compound across both). Top pick.

entries.name: Unit Damage Doctrine V
entries.text: Fallback if not running Leadership. Filler.

doctrines.note: Veterancy: Full Top (recommended, DPS) / Full Bot (Skirmish, Relentless Advancing capstone renames the unit). Hero pairing: not specified in this thread. Ability infos per OP follow-up reply (2025-06-10): Arrow Rain has 160m range, 14s duration; Spell 1 has 7s duration. Playstyle: stack first (40 unit kills or 8 hero kills, or a mix) until unlocked -- this stacks even when the unit isn't deployed, from both hero and unit kills, and unlocks advanced abilities. Then play in blob: Skill 1 ignores most shields and does insane damage, Skill 2 to reposition and dodge threats. Artemis and Arrow Rain DON'T stack. Normal combo: 1 -> Arrow Rain -> V+Artemis -> 1 (wait for each step to end before the next; can skip the Artemis step). No dedicated Tips & Tricks section beyond Playstyle/Ability-infos notes (OP gap, not fabricated). 'Don't put' is a literal X placeholder in the OP. Edit timestamp (2026-05-27) pre-dates the 2026-06-25 Chaos patch anchor; Hwarang is NOT on the 13-unit Chaos shortlist, so staleAsOfPatch is not forced — noting pre-patch authorship per instructions only.

steps.text: Stack them first (40 unit kills or 8 hero kills, or a mix of both) until unlocked -- this unlocks their advanced abilities. Stacks even when the unit isn't deployed, from both hero kills and unit kills.
Play in blob. Skill 1 ignores most shields and does insane damage. Skill 2 to reposition and dodge potential threats.
Artemis and Arrow Rain DON'T stack. Normal combo: 1 -> Arrow Rain -> V+Artemis -> 1 (wait for each step to end before going to the next); can be played without Artemis by skipping that step.
